## Load Data
```{r}
library(foreign)
library(stats)
library(mgcv)
library(splines)
library(nlme)
dat <- read.csv("hou_pm.csv")
```

## Summary Stats

```{r}
summary(dat)
hist(dat$TEMP)
hist(dat$resp)
hist(dat$cvd)
hist(dat$tot)

plot(dat$tot)
plot(dat$TEMP)
plot(dat$RH)
```
```{r}
hist(dat$tot)
	summary(dat$tot)
	mean(dat$tot)
	var(dat$tot)
```
Variance is about equal to the mean, so we'll use a poisson distribution. 


## Plot TOT model
```{r}
mod1<-gam(tot ~ s(pm25,k=4,fx=TRUE) + s(RH,k=4,fx=TRUE) + as.factor(dow) + s(TEMP,k=4,fx=TRUE),
          family=quasipoisson, data=dat, na.action=na.omit)
  summary(mod1)


  plot(dat$tot)
  plot(mod1,scale=0)
  plot(resid(mod1))
```


```{r}
hist(dat$tot) 
	summary(dat$tot)
	mean(dat$tot)
	var(dat$tot)
```


## Plot CVD model
```{r}
mod_cvd<-gam(cvd ~ s(pm25,k=4,fx=TRUE) + s(RH,k=4,fx=TRUE) + as.factor(dow) + s(TEMP,k=4,fx=TRUE),
          family=quasipoisson, data=dat, na.action=na.omit)
  summary(mod_cvd)


  plot(dat$cvd)
  plot(mod_cvd,scale=0)
  plot(resid(mod_cvd))
```


## Plot resp model
```{r}
mod_resp<-gam(resp ~ s(pm25,k=4,fx=TRUE) + s(RH,k=4,fx=TRUE) + as.factor(dow) + s(TEMP,k=4,fx=TRUE),
          family=quasipoisson, data=dat, na.action=na.omit)
  summary(mod_resp)


  plot(dat$resp)
  plot(mod_resp,scale=0)
  plot(resid(mod_resp))
```


- assuming that the effect of 30 degrees is the same no matter when that 30 degrees occurs 
  - testable hypothesis
